scope: every struct, field and enum name known to the game's metadata parser (GTA VI, Xbox build 1.0.2.1)

by_origin.origin: Names used in the scanned data files
Names found only in the executable's tables

accuracy.note: The exact text exists elsewhere, and about one such name in 4,000 is expected to be a chance collision. The largest loose sources are filtered to names built from words that parser names use.

Accepted automatically where random decoy hashes show few chance matches. The decoy counts put chance matches at about 3 to 4% of these names. In a holdout test the cracker accepted 520 hidden known names: 518 right, 2 wrong.

Picked by a language model from candidates that hash correctly. In holdout tests on 825 hidden known names, mixed with as many unknown ones, Claude Opus 5.5 accepted 167 (all right) and Claude Fable 5.2 accepted 197 (196 right, 1 wrong). Scaled to the lines judged for real, that suggests 1 to 2% of judged names are wrong, with a wide margin. The hidden names come from earlier games and may be easier than the unknown ones.
